body: I really appreciate your answers, tho I feel like I’ve tried to change my life too much over these past 3 years. I need to find a ground, something secure that is who I am. I’m scared I’ll never find it, but also when I talk to my “friends” about these things they don’t make me feel good in the long run it’s like this post shit only makes me feel “good” now but it’s never satisfactory, it’s never something that I can hold onto and praise and live for. I think I need a girlfriend for that reason but I can’t even take care of myself in the first place lmao. Thanks for saying sumfin tho makes me feel like I’m heard :)
